card.name: Small words in dental and mouth text
card.fires_on: Small linking words (from, or, to, the, properly) right after teeth, chewing, eating or rinsing in dental-care text. A few stray hits on linking words elsewhere.

modes.label: Linking word after teeth or mouth actions
modes.description: Words like from, or, to following teeth, chew, eat or rinse, before a verb about the mouth.
modes.example: Prevents remaining teeth<< from>> drifting out of position

modes.label: Instructions on eating or rinsing
modes.description: The word or in lists of things a patient should not do after dental treatment.
modes.example: Instruct patient not to eat, drink<< or>> rinse for at least 30 minutes

modes.label: Stray hits outside dental text
modes.description: Linking words in unrelated named phrases.
modes.example: Rivest is an inventor of<< the>> RSA public"key cryptosystem.

card.writes: It seems to push toward word beginnings like -t, hairs, and bone, and away from cavity and decay words.
